STORY-FEAT4-021.title: Implement External Link Construction and Validation
STORY-FEAT4-021.description: Enhance provider detail service to construct state medical board and research URLs and validate them using the URL guardian to ensure links are safe, reachable, and properly formatted.

STORY-FEAT4-022.title: Add Robust Error Handling and Fallbacks for NPI API
STORY-FEAT4-022.description: Implement retry logic, timeout handling, and graceful fallbacks for NPI Registry API failures to ensure provider detail lookup remains reliable under partial outages or malformed responses.

STORY-FEAT4-023.title: Add Debug Logging and Observability for Provider Lookup
STORY-FEAT4-023.description: Integrate debug logging for provider detail requests, including NPI queries, response status, and error conditions, leveraging existing debug_logger infrastructure for traceability and monitoring.
